title: Over-Achievement Bonus Schedule for Earned Pals Rewards Tiers
content:
When an earned free tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** is applied, an over-achievement bonus is added according to the membership's net qualifying spend over the last 12 months — the qualifying spend of its points-earning entries dated in the last 12 months, less that of its points-reversal entries dated in the same period — measured against the qualifying spend threshold of the tier being applied: $250.00 for Pals Rewards Insider, $750.00 for Pals Rewards VIP.

| Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months | Over-achievement bonus |
|---|---|
| at least 1.4 times the threshold | 250 points |
| at least 1.05 times but below 1.4 times the threshold | 100 points |
| below 1.05 times the threshold | none |

### The bands in dollars

| Tier being applied | 250 points from | 100 points from | No bonus below |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Insider ($250.00) | $350.00 | $262.50 up to $349.99 | $262.50 |
| Pals Rewards VIP ($750.00) | $1,050.00 | $787.50 up to $1,049.99 | $787.50 |

### Both sides of each line (hypothetical spend, Pals Rewards VIP being applied)

- $1,049.99: 100 points; $1,050.00: 250 points.
- $787.49: none; $787.50: 100 points.
